text: Mending is not a private miracle. Seat a Strand and your pad notices. Seat nine and the cut above your pad closes.
Read every tablet. Strike the Silent Drum when you are ready. Offer at hearths. Ask politely, smaller than the old world asked.
The world does not snap back. It learns to hold.

pages.title: The tablets
text: The tribes left twelve stone tablets behind. Look for them on the walls of Seal-carver camps and, in the March, in sunken **Ancestor Halls**, Drum Circles and Crystal Spires. Right-click one to read it.
Each tablet you read is recorded here, in the Lore chapter, and its words open as a page of their own.
The chapter counts how many of the twelve you have read. Tablets you have not found yet stay hidden.

pages.title: Tablets of your own
text: You can craft Lore Tablets from March Stone and an Echo Shard to hang in a hall of your own. A crafted tablet carries the first fragment, the Pad-keepers' Hearth; in creative, sneak-use it to cycle through the twelve.
A tablet has to hang on the side of a solid block.
